summary: Verified Payment Approval Workflow end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 12 pytest backend tests PASS and full UI flows (kiosk submit → admin approve) work correctly. PendingApprovalBell badge updates, ApprovePaymentSheet + SignaturePad function, payment persists with status='approved', signature_data_url, approved_by, approved_at. Legacy /api/kiosk/payments (without employee_id) still auto-approves (backward compat). Reject flow also works. No critical issues found.

issues: 'Wacht op goedkeuring' pending section is only rendered inside the md:hidden mobile container (Payments.jsx line 750, 796). On desktop viewport (>=md/768px) the amber pending section is NOT visible — only the PendingApprovalBell badge is shown. The desktop view at line 874 (hidden md:block) has no equivalent pending-section. If admin should be able to approve on desktop as well, replicate the pending section in the desktop layout. Currently admin must use a phone-sized viewport (or zoom/responsive mode) to see and approve pending payments.

action_items: Optional UX improvement: also render the 'Wacht op goedkeuring' pending section inside the desktop (hidden md:block) view in /app/frontend/src/pages/vastgoed/admin/Payments.jsx so admins on desktop can approve directly (currently only mobile viewport shows the section; bell badge IS visible on desktop).

Pending approval section is duplicated logic risk: only rendered in mobile branch — desktop admins lose feature parity.
Signature canvas validation works (hasSig flag gates the Goedkeuren button) — good.
Approve endpoint properly stores approved_by, approved_at, signature_data_url and decrements pending-count — verified.
